 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. It's never too early to start looking ahead to the 2027 NFL Draft, right?
 Week 10 of the current NFL season isn't over yet, but the order for the draft in a few months is already starting to take shape. And, at least for now, the Los Angeles Chargers are still very much in control of the No. 1 overall pick.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The Chargers will enter their "Monday Night Football" matchup with the Baltimore Ravens as the league's only winless team. They sit at just 0-8 on the year.
 But if the Chargers win on Monday night in Baltimore, they'll join both the Tennessee Titans and Miami Dolphins with 1-8 records. The Titans fell to the Jacksonville Jaguars in a 40-23 blowout on Sunday afternoon, which marked their third straight loss and moved them to 0-5 at Nissan Stadium this season. The Dolphins barely lost to the Indianapolis Colts 24-22 on Sunday. The win snapped the Colts' five-game losing skid, yet the victory moved them to only 3-7 on the year. The Dolphins have lost three straight heading into a road game against the Buffalo Bills next week. 
 While they have the same record, the Titans currently have the edge over the Dolphins for the No. 2 overall pick. The New York Jets and Philadelphia Eagles round out the top five.
 Even though things are undoubtedly bad, the Chargers will realistically win at least one game the rest of the way. The NFL hasn't seen a team go a full season without winning a game since the 2017 Cleveland Browns. That means that either the Titans or Dolphins can sneak in and steal the No. 1 overall draft pick from the Chargers down the stretch. The Jets and Eagles, both with just two wins this season, aren't out of the question yet, either.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement For now, though, the Chargers are in control of that top spot.
 2027 NFL Draft order 
 As of Sunday, Nov. 15, via Tankathon 
 1. Los Angeles Chargers (0-8)* 
2. Tennessee Titans (1-8)
3. Miami Dolphins (1-8)
4. New York Jets (2-8)
5. Philadelphia Eagles (2-7)
6. New York Jets (via 3-7 Indianapolis Colts)
7. Arizona Cardinals (3-7)
8. Atlanta Falcons (3-7)
9. Houston Texans (3-6)
10. Tampa Bay Buccaneers (3-6)
11. New Orleans Saints (3-6)
12. Washington Commanders (3-5-1)
13. New York Jets (via 4-6 Dallas Cowboys)
14. Las Vegas Raiders (4-6)
 15. Baltimore Ravens (4-5)* 
16. New England Patriots (5-5)
17. Seattle Seahawks (6-4)
18. Cleveland Browns (via 6-4 Los Angeles Rams)
 *The Chargers and Ravens will play their Week 10 game on Monday night.
